description: A CDN stylesheet URL redirects (302) to the page host, which answers 404: critical silently drops it.

thin.note: The host of the LAST URL requested for the stylesheet (after redirects) is compared with the host of the final page URL: here the page host, so the failure fails the job. If the host written in the page decided instead (the CDN), this would be skipped. (In these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port: the stylesheet same-host rule compares hostname:port with the scheme ignored, the notion the url() rebasing uses.)
